papers_read.title_as_printed: A Two-Stage Model for Predicting Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease Conversion (Lu et al., Front Aging Neurosci 2022)
Early MCI-to-AD Conversion Prediction Using Future Value Forecasting of Multimodal Features (Minhas et al., Comput Intell Neurosci 2021)

what_each_reports.P-199: 3D ResNet-50 (Med3D init + MoCo) on baseline structural MRI only; 577 ADNI MCI (297 sMCI/280 pMCI, 36-month window); random 80/20 split; test Acc 0.819 (95% CI 0.798-0.841), AUC 0.835.
what_each_reports.P-186: Linear SVM on three-visit trajectories (last visit forecast by weighted gradient offset) of 8 neuropsychological measures + FreeSurfer MRI features; ADNI-1 MCI with complete follow-up; 5-fold CV. 1-year-ahead NM+MRI AUC 95.7% (n=85, 9 features); 6-month-ahead 91.2% (n=119). MRI-only: 88% (6-month) and 90.5% (1-year).

quantity_a: Test-set AUC for 36-month pMCI vs sMCI from one baseline raw T1 MRI image, 577 ADNI MCI, internal held-out split.
quantity_b: 5-fold CV AUC for MCIp (conversion by month 36) vs MCIs in an 85-subject complete-follow-up ADNI-1 subsample, from three-visit cognitive + FreeSurfer-feature trajectories including a forecast value at the time of conversion.
incompatible_if_same: Not established: P-186 gives no AUC interval, and with 85 subjects in 5-fold CV the uncertainty is large; neither paper claims an ordering the other refutes.

gates.task: match: T2 MCI-to-AD conversion, both with a 36-month conversion definition
gates.dataset_family: match: ADNI (P-186 ADNI-1 subset; P-199 ADNI MCI baseline); participants likely overlap
gates.validation_tier: match: both internal (held-out split vs 5-fold CV)
gates.modality_family: mismatch: P-199 structural MRI image only; P-186 neuropsychological tests + tabular FreeSurfer features; no waiver on record

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: same metric type (AUC) but different predictor set (image only vs cognition + MRI features), input representation (single baseline image vs three-visit trajectories with a forecast conversion-time value), and population (577 baseline MCI vs 85 complete-follow-up ADNI-1 MCI)
performance_validity: flag does not apply: 0.835 and 0.957 are below 0.97; P-186 normalises before the train-test split and picks the subset size from results, so its 0.957 is optimistic
independence: Distinct author groups; both use ADNI (shared cohort, recorded as non-independence).
grounds: P-186's 0.957 comes from longitudinal trajectories of cognitive tests and MRI features that include a forecast value at the conversion time point, whereas P-199 uses a single baseline MRI image, so predictor set and input representation differ.
P-186 evaluates 85 ADNI-1 subjects with three consecutive annual visits, a selected complete-follow-up subsample, whereas P-199 evaluates baseline MCI broadly (577), so the population differs.
P-186 attributes its high AUC to the forecast conversion-time feature, which is a design choice absent from P-199, not a competing estimate of the same quantity.

evidence_quotes.quote: To prevent data leakage, only participants' baseline data were selected in this study.
ResNet-50 achieved the best performance with an accuracy of 0.819 and an AUC of 0.835
for 1-year-ahead prediction, the dataset contains three consecutive annual readings, resulting in 35 MCIp and 50 MCIs subjects.

The method proposed in this paper has recorded the highest classification AUC of 95.7% predominantly because of involving the forecasted marker value at the time of conversion as a classification feature.
We scale all features to have values between 0 and 1 before the train-test split.

record_defects: resolution_note says 'Confirmed genuine' on metric type and gap alone while resolution says 'Rejected: Task, dataset, or modality mismatch'.
claim_b uses 0.957 (1-year, n=85) while P-186's registry Best_Metric is 'AUC 0.912' (6-month, n=119); the claim states neither horizon nor n.
The bridging-evidence list names no condition separating the two results.
what_would_change_the_verdict: A baseline-only, image-only P-186-type result (or a longitudinal cognition-plus-MRI P-199 result) on a comparable ADNI MCI population, with intervals that exclude each other.
